purpose: A line tab of a line-variant TabMenu: the selected item carries a 2px accent bar on its bottom or left edge.

notFor.case: Not for standalone use outside a TabMenu.
A tab in a button-variant TabMenu.
A link in a header or navbar.

Focused.visual: Ink Content/secondary; a Border/focus stroke round the whole item with the Border/ring/default ring.

Selected.visual: Ink Content/accent, no fill; an indicator in Border/accent, Stroke/focus thick, on the bottom (or left) edge; aria-pressed="true".

a11y.keyboard: Tab reaches it unless disabled; Space or Enter activates it.
a11y.reducedMotion: Ink changes run on use-hover, which keeps its duration under reduced motion: a colour change, not travel (lib/motion.ts KEEP_UNDER_REDUCED).

openQuestions: Focus draws a full 2px stroke round the item although the selection is a bar (tab-menu-contract.md). Intended?
